helpers.name: SceneResource_ClearC000AndWritePhaseRows
helpers.semantics: Clears the initial C000 scene block and emits sixteen phase-selected row pairs using the 32-word table at 0x00002080.

helpers.name: SceneResource_LoadC000AndRunFrameService
helpers.semantics: Loads caller-provided C000 and palette/command-stream inputs, performs the actor/render service and fixed palette uploads, then waits, fades, and releases the scene presentation.

helpers.name: SceneResource_RunSharedC000Presentation
helpers.semantics: Loads the shared graphics resource to C000, uploads its palette, emits the fixed fill/presentation sequence, and completes through the common wait/fade/reset services.

reachability: All three bodies are exact RTS-delimited code regions, but no direct static selector is exported. This finding records their low-level contracts without inventing a scene-state role.
conclusion: Three complete scene-resource service bodies previously hidden inside UNKNOWN layout gaps are now canonical code owners. The neighboring 0x001B4F02-0x001B4F03 RTS stub and other alternate-entry gaps remain intentionally unresolved.
